selection.rule: Dependency-complete first 24 questions from the question-sheet selection order.

questions.question: What picture are readers asked to imagine at the beginning of the passage?
questions.answer: They are asked to picture a time of ignorance and rough living, when people were surrounded by unawareness and saw things as lifeless.

questions.question: What kind of place is the earlier world compared to before the Qur’an’s light appears?
questions.answer: It is compared to a desert of harshness and ignorance.

questions.question: How are worldly things first pictured in that condition?
questions.answer: They are pictured as if they have no life or deeper meaning.

questions.question: How is the earth described in that same scene?
questions.answer: It is pictured like a head, with land and sea like tongues, and living things like words of praise.

questions.question: In the scene described, what role do the stars play?
questions.answer: They act like shining messages that show truth and wisdom.

questions.question: Why does the passage say we may not notice this easily today?
questions.answer: Because we know these verses so well that we may stop feeling their original power.

questions.question: Why is looking only through familiarity a problem?
questions.answer: It hides the darkness that each verse removed and makes the miracle harder to notice.

questions.question: What two things does each verse scatter according to the passage?
questions.answer: It scatters darkness and spreads guidance-filled light.

questions.question: Why does the passage end by mentioning a comparison?
questions.answer: Because a comparison will help explain the miracle in a clearer and stronger way.

questions.question: What two dark conditions are people asked to imagine from the earlier time?
questions.answer: They are asked to imagine ignorance and heedlessness covering life.

questions.question: What covered everything in that imagined time?
questions.answer: Ignorance, neglect, and the idea that things were just lifeless parts of nature.

questions.question: What breaks into that darkness all of a sudden?
questions.answer: The Qur’an’s message comes with light, guidance, and miraculous power.

questions.question: According to the passage, what does the sky look like in this new view?
questions.answer: It looks like a mouth speaking.

questions.question: What do these images show about creation?
questions.answer: They show that all parts of creation point to Allah and glorify Him.

questions.question: What does this way of describing creation help a believer understand?
questions.answer: It helps a believer understand that the whole universe is connected to worship of Allah.

questions.question: Why are the Qur’an’s verses compared to shining stars in this passage?
questions.answer: Because they give light and remove darkness from disbelief.

questions.question: What kind of human condition is described before that light appears?
questions.answer: People are described as living in ignorance, carelessness, and spiritual darkness.

questions.question: At the start of the passage, what does a person need to do in order to value the verses properly?
questions.answer: The person needs to imagine the world before the light of guidance had changed people’s understanding.

questions.question: How does the passage help listeners picture the earth after hearing the verses?
questions.answer: It presents the earth as if it had a head and many tongues.

questions.question: What does the passage ask readers to appreciate about each verse of the Qur’an?
questions.answer: That each verse shines with guidance and drives away disbelief.

questions.question: When the verse about everything in the heavens and earth praising Allah is heard, how do creatures seem in people’s minds?
questions.answer: They seem to come alive, wake up, and begin showing Allah’s names.

questions.question: To understand the verses better, what earlier age are readers told to imagine?
questions.answer: They are told to imagine a time before guidance spread, when ignorance was strong.

questions.question: What change begins when Qur’anic verses are heard?
questions.answer: People begin to see the world as alive with meaning and full of signs pointing to Allah.

questions.question: How does the passage help listeners picture the sky after hearing the verses?
questions.answer: It presents the sky as if it were speaking.

title: Reviving Effect of Verses in the Age of Ignorance
